## 描述

Caterpillar hydraulic return oil filter under part 1194740. The catalogue confirms the Cat reference and the machinery application, with pressure, micron and flow figures all unpublished. As a return-line element it protects the reservoir side of the circuit, so its duty follows the return flow. Buyers should provide flow and operating pressure, state the ISO 4406 target, and request pressure-drop and beta-ratio data before ordering.
